rec.label: Per-hall snapshots
rec.formula: projection of the authored per-hall inputs

rec.label: Campus cabinet count
rec.formula: hall_count x racks_per_hall

rec.label: Distribution transformers installed
rec.formula: per stream per hall x streams x halls

rec.label: Distribution transformer efficiency at design load (lower bound)
rec.formula: P / (P + loss), P = kVA L pf

rec.label: Distribution transformer FLA at 0.4 kV
rec.formula: kVA x 1000 / (sqrt3 x V)

rec.label: Distribution transformer FLA at 20 kV
rec.formula: kVA / (sqrt3 x kV)

rec.label: Distribution transformer loading, one stream
rec.formula: hall kVA / (units x kVA) x 100

rec.label: Distribution transformer loss at design load (upper bound)
rec.formula: (P0 + Pk L^2) / 1000, L = design load fraction

rec.label: Distribution transformer no-load loss (EU Tier 2 maximum)

source.section: Table I.2, 3 150 kVA, Tier 2 (1 July 2021), maximum no-load losses

rec.label: Distribution transformers per stream per hall
rec.formula: ceil(hall kW / pf / kVA): one stream alone carries the hall

rec.label: Distribution transformer load loss (EU Tier 2 maximum)

source.section: Table I.2, 3 150 kVA, Tier 2 (1 July 2021), maximum load losses

rec.label: LV fault referred to 20 kV
rec.formula: LV board fault seen on the 20 kV side = kVA / ((source z + Z%/100) x sqrt3 x kV_mv); the LV voltage cancels

rec.label: EPMS metered total
rec.formula: facility load at the EPMS metering point

rec.label: Gensets installed
rec.formula: per hall x halls

rec.label: Gensets per hall
rec.formula: ceil(hall kW / (unit kW x max loading)) + spare

rec.label: Hall design facility load
rec.formula: hall it_design_kw x site PUE

rec.label: 150 kV source fault MVA
rec.formula: sqrt3 x kV x kA

rec.label: Power transformer FLA at 150 kV
rec.formula: MVA x 1000 / (sqrt3 x kV)

rec.label: Power transformer loading, one unit lost
rec.formula: demand / ((count - 1) x rating) x 100

rec.label: Power transformer rating
rec.formula: smallest IEC 60076-1 R10 rating (31.5, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100 MVA) >= hv_tx_sizing_mva

rec.label: Power transformer minimum Peak Efficiency Index (EU Tier 2)

source.section: Table I.7, liquid-immersed large power, 63 MVA, Tier 2

rec.label: LV board fault level
rec.formula: MVA / ((MVA / 20 kV fault MVA + Z%/100) x sqrt3 x kV_lv); the 20 kV fault MVA does not depend on the 20 kV voltage

rec.label: 20 kV earth-fault current (NGR limited)
rec.formula: kV x 1000 / sqrt3 / R

rec.label: 20 kV fault level, one transformer
rec.formula: tx MVA / ((tx MVA / source MVA + Z%/100) x sqrt3 x kV); bus tie open

rec.label: Power transformer FLA at 20 kV
rec.formula: MVA x 1000 / (sqrt3 x kV)

source.section: MODEL.electrical (LV below the distribution transformer, engine 2.9.0)

rec.label: Usable PDU capacity
rec.formula: kVA x pf x maximum loading

rec.label: PDU loading, one stream carries the hall
rec.formula: hall IT design kW / (PDUs x kVA x pf)

rec.label: PDU loading, both streams in service
rec.formula: hall IT design kW / streams / (PDUs x kVA x pf)

rec.label: Floor PDUs per stream per hall
rec.formula: ceil(hall IT design kW / usable PDU kW): 2N, one stream alone carries the hall

rec.label: IT load power factor at the PDU

source.section: MODEL.electrical (LV below the distribution transformer, engine 2.9.0)

rec.label: 20 kV feeder 50 pickup
rec.formula: instantaneous multiple x LV through-fault at 20 kV

rec.label: 20 kV feeder 51 pickup
rec.formula: pickup multiple x transformer FLA at 20 kV

rec.label: 20 kV feeder 51 TMS (extremely inverse)
rec.formula: smallest TMS step meeting BOTH: EI time at LV Isd (20 kV) >= LV long-time time there + margin, and EI time at the LV through-fault >= LV short-time delay + margin

rec.label: 150 kV transformer feeder 51 pickup
rec.formula: pickup multiple x power transformer FLA at 150 kV

rec.label: 150 kV transformer feeder 51 TMS
rec.formula: smallest TMS step with standard-inverse time at the referred 20 kV fault >= incomer time + margin

rec.label: 20 kV incomer 51 pickup
rec.formula: pickup multiple x power transformer FLA at 20 kV

rec.label: 20 kV incomer 51 TMS
rec.formula: smallest TMS step with standard-inverse time at the 20 kV fault >= feeder time there + margin

rec.label: LV main long-time pickup Ir
rec.formula: Ir = distribution transformer FLA at 0.4 kV

rec.label: LV main short-time pickup Isd
rec.formula: Isd multiple x Ir

rec.label: Cabinets per PDU (per stream)
rec.formula: ceil(hall racks / PDUs per stream)

rec.label: Cabinet rows per hall
rec.formula: hall racks / cabinets per row

rec.label: UPS system loading, normal
rec.formula: (it_load_kw / ups_system_count) / ups_system_rated_kw x 100

rec.label: UPS module load
rec.formula: ups output / module count

rec.label: Modules per UPS system
rec.formula: ceil(site.it_design_kw / ups_module_kw_rated)

rec.label: UPS system load
rec.formula: ups output / system count

rec.label: UPS system rating
rec.formula: modules_per_system x module rating

rec.label: Basis statement
rec.value: Adopted project scenario — simulated, not measured telemetry

rec.label: Facility load
rec.formula: it_load_kw x pue

rec.label: Site IT load
rec.formula: campus.it_load_kw

rec.label: Non-IT load
rec.formula: facility_load_kw - it_load_kw

rec.label: Design PUE
rec.formula: authored design point
